intro.title: Traditional Sauna Ritual
intro.quote: "Bathe in the sauna with a fresh birch whisk, and your body will stay white."
intro.description: A SAUNA RITUAL is a sauna visit led by a professional sauna master – for one, for two or for a larger group. Unwind completely and discover new sensations.
features: Relaxing Herbal Hot Tubs with the Healing Power of Nature
A Refreshing Pond All Year Round

experience.title: The Full Sauna Ritual
experience.subtitle: Seven steps that bring together traditional Latvian sauna practice and our sauna masters' own touch.

steps.title: Warming in the Herbal Hot Tub
steps.description: The ritual begins in a gently warm herbal hot tub that prepares body and mind for the sauna. Fragrant herbs help you relax and let go of everyday stress.

steps.title: Herbal Tea
steps.description: Warm medicinal herbal tea, rich in natural vitamins and minerals, readies the body for the steps ahead.

steps.title: Whisking
steps.description: Whisking is the heart of the sauna ritual. The sauna master works over the body with steamed birch, oak and other leafy whisks – fanning hot steam, pressing and gently patting – to bring deep relaxation, stimulate circulation and cleanse the skin.

steps.title: Herbal Scrub
steps.description: A scrub of medicinal herbs and salt gently removes dead skin cells and leaves the skin renewed.

steps.title: Warm Honey Massage
steps.description: Warm honey is massaged into the skin to moisturise it deeply, leaving it soft, clear and glowing. It calms the mind as well.

steps.title: A Dip in the Cool Pond
steps.description: After the whisking, the sauna master leads you to the cool pond for a dip. The cold water cools the skin and invigorates the circulation.

steps.title: Resting in Warm Blankets
steps.description: After the hot-and-cold contrast, you are wrapped in warm blankets to rest in the fresh air. This quiet rest settles the circulation and closes the ritual in complete peace.
